_about: Finishes for Generate Photo Spot (photogen.py), from the designer's renders in renders/. Finishes only, never furniture or layout: the view to edit already has every object in place. 'all' goes with every view, then the entry for each room in shot. 'swatches' are crops of the renders (box = left, top, right, bottom as fractions of the image) laid out as one labelled material board. The server re-reads this file on every run.
all: Walls: warm cream-beige limewash plaster with a soft mottled, hand-troweled texture and gentle tonal variation (never flat white paint), slim oak skirting.
Ceilings: flat warm off-white; recessed downlights stay small and round; where the model shows LED strips, they glow warm (2700 K).
Floors: honey-coloured natural oak boards with a fine, real grain and soft sheen; bathrooms in large-format pale beige stone tiles.
Doors: flush honey-oak leaves with a fine vertical grain, no plank grooves, in slim matching oak frames, with slim brushed-steel lever handles.
Joinery: honey oak or darker walnut with flat fronts; white or marble tops.
Fabrics: cream and oatmeal boucle and linen; cushions in blush, sage, slate blue and soft mustard; chunky knitted throws; textured cream rugs.
Metal and glass: brass and bronze fittings, opal glass globes, brushed nickel in bathrooms.
Light: warm and soft, golden daylight from the windows, gentle long shadows, a slightly hazy warm glow, like the designer's renders.

rooms.MASTER BEDROOM: Headboard panels in cream boucle; bed in white linen with a sage quilted cover, blush and cream cushions and a chunky cream knitted throw; bedside chests in walnut; pendants are opal glass globes on thin brass rods; the canvas above the bed is a soft abstract in blush, terracotta, sage and cream in a thin oak frame with a brass picture light.
rooms.TOILET 1: Honey-oak horizontal slatted cladding, pale beige large stone tiles, a white solid-surface top, walnut drawers, brushed-nickel fittings, a white wall-hung WC, warm LED strips under the vanity and cabinets.
rooms.TOILET 2: Beige travertine-look stone tiles, a horizontal oak slat-look feature wall, a grey travertine counter with a white vessel basin, walnut drawers, a dark bronze mirror frame, brushed-bronze fittings.
rooms.RECEPTION: Cream linen sofas on walnut plinths; slate-blue, sage and blush cushions; marble and fluted walnut coffee table; oak niche shelves lit warm; textured cream jute rug.
rooms.DINING: Walnut table; cream boucle chairs on walnut legs; warm fabric pendants; walnut sideboard and cabinets; textured cream rug.
rooms.LIVING ROOM: Oatmeal-greige textured sofa with blush, sage, slate and mustard cushions; travertine and walnut coffee table; walnut TV console with a cream top; shaggy cream rug.
rooms.KITCHEN: Matt white-greige flat base units, honey-oak wall units and shelves, grey-beige veined marble splashback, white worktop with a thin black edge, black appliances, warm plinth LED.
rooms.LAUNDRY: Honey-oak flat-panel cabinets with slim recessed handles, beige stone counter, pale beige stone floor tiles, white walls.
rooms.ENTRANCE: Mottled limewash walls, honey-oak trim and arched niche linings with a warm LED cove, cream upholstered bench, opal wall sconces, a runner rug with blush, sage and cream ovals.
rooms.HALLWAY: Corridor finishes as in the entrance: mottled warm limewash walls, honey-oak floor and skirting, honey-oak door leaves and frames, opal or fabric wall sconces with a warm glow, cream boucle bench, a runner rug in blush, sage and cream.
rooms.TERRACE: Warm brown timber-look decking, walnut-tone bench base and cabinets, cream cushions with sage, blush, mustard and slate, travertine-look table, cream rendered walls, terracotta roof tiles, golden-hour sky; the counter has no sink.

swatches.label: CORRIDOR: walls, oak trim, LED cove
